storyCards.fact:
The Weeknd's "Six Feet Under" reached #34 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Six Feet Under" is a song by Canadian singer-songwriter the Weeknd, from his third studio album Starboy (2016).

The song peaked at #34 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 4 weeks on the chart.

Six Feet Under was released in 2016.
